'''Thersin Dol''' was once a simple hunter of [[Frostwall Village]], but greed and cruelty marked his path. Promised a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] by an offworld [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who trafficked in exotic beasts, he entered the [[Caves of Light and Shadow]]. There, he wounded a mother [[Icewolf]] and stole her cubs, showing no pity as he left her bleeding and broken. His contempt seeped into the very stones, and from his act of spite the caves became tainted, their [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]] darkened by the echo of his cruelty. When the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]'s corruption spread across the valley, Dol vanished into the wilderness and never returned to his people.<ref name="Lure of the Lost" />

==Behind the scenes==
Thersin Dol appears in [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[2015]] downloadable [[roleplaying game]] adventure ''[[Lure of the Lost]]''.
